title: Prepositions and Places — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: "I live on Surabaya." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Untuk kota dipakai in: I live in Surabaya.

items.prompt: "The picture is in the wall." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Gambar menempel di dinding: on the wall.

items.prompt: "My birthday is in Monday." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Untuk hari dipakai on: on Monday.

items.prompt: Look at the picture. Which sentence about the ball is correct?

visual.text: The ball is next to the box.

choices.say: The ball is next to the box.

visual.text: The ball is in the box.

choices.say: The ball is in the box.

visual.text: The ball is on the box.

choices.say: The ball is on the box.

visual.text: The ball is under the box.

choices.say: The ball is under the box.

items.reteach: Bola ada di samping kotak: next to.

items.prompt: "We go to school at the morning." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Kita bilang in the morning.

items.prompt: Which sentence about Dad is correct?

visual.text: Dad is in at the office.

choices.say: Dad is in at the office.

items.reteach: Pola: at the office.

items.prompt: "The bird is flying under the sky." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Burung terbang di langit: in the sky.

items.prompt: Which sentence about the shoes is correct?

visual.text: My shoes are in front of the door.

choices.say: My shoes are in front of the door.

visual.text: My shoes are in front the door.

choices.say: My shoes are in front the door.

visual.text: My shoes are front of the door.

choices.say: My shoes are front of the door.

visual.text: My shoes are in of front the door.

choices.say: My shoes are in of front the door.

items.reteach: Lengkapnya in front of.

items.prompt: "Fish live on the sea." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Ikan hidup di dalam laut: in the sea.

items.prompt: Look at the picture. Which sentence about the dog is correct?

visual.text: The dog is under the table.

choices.say: The dog is under the table.

visual.text: The dog is on the table.

choices.say: The dog is on the table.

visual.text: The dog is next to the table.

choices.say: The dog is next to the table.

visual.text: The dog is in the table.

choices.say: The dog is in the table.

items.reteach: Anjing ada di bawah meja: under.

items.prompt: "We play football in the park at Sunday." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Untuk hari dipakai on: on Sunday.

items.prompt: Which sentence about the market is correct?

visual.text: The market is between the bank and the school.

choices.say: The market is between the bank and the school.

visual.text: The market is between of the bank and the school.

choices.say: The market is between of the bank and the school.

visual.text: The market is between the bank to the school.

choices.say: The market is between the bank to the school.

visual.text: The market is the between bank and the school.

choices.say: The market is the between bank and the school.

items.reteach: Polanya between … and …

items.prompt: Where is the bag in the bedroom?

stimulus.text: My bedroom is small. My bed is next to the window. My bag is under the desk. My doll is on the bed.

items.reteach: My bag is under the desk.

items.prompt: What is on the bed in the bedroom?

stimulus.text: My bedroom is small. My bed is next to the window. My bag is under the desk. My doll is on the bed.

items.reteach: My doll is on the bed.

items.prompt: What is next to the window in the bedroom?

stimulus.text: My bedroom is small. My bed is next to the window. My bag is under the desk. My doll is on the bed.

items.reteach: My bed is next to the window.

items.prompt: Where is the toilet in Taman Bungkul?

stimulus.text: WELCOME TO TAMAN BUNGKUL. The toilet is next to the gate. The playground is behind the pond. Please keep the park clean.

items.reteach: The toilet is next to the gate.

items.prompt: What is behind the pond in Taman Bungkul?

stimulus.text: WELCOME TO TAMAN BUNGKUL. The toilet is next to the gate. The playground is behind the pond. Please keep the park clean.

items.reteach: The playground is behind the pond.

items.prompt: What must visitors do in Taman Bungkul?

stimulus.text: WELCOME TO TAMAN BUNGKUL. The toilet is next to the gate. The playground is behind the pond. Please keep the park clean.

items.reteach: Please keep the park clean.

items.prompt: Where is the canteen at our school?

visual.text: between the library and the office

choices.say: between the library and the office

items.reteach: Baris Canteen: behind the hall.

items.prompt: Which place is next to Class 1?
items.reteach: Baris Library: next to Class 1.

items.prompt: The clinic is between the library and …
items.reteach: Clinic: between library and office.

items.prompt: Where does Dika's family walk?

stimulus.text: Every Sunday, Dika goes to Malang with his family. They walk around Alun-Alun Malang. Then they eat bakso near the station.

items.reteach: They walk around Alun-Alun Malang.

items.prompt: Where does Dika's family eat bakso?

stimulus.text: Every Sunday, Dika goes to Malang with his family. They walk around Alun-Alun Malang. Then they eat bakso near the station.

items.reteach: They eat bakso near the station.

items.prompt: When does Dika go to Malang?

stimulus.text: Every Sunday, Dika goes to Malang with his family. They walk around Alun-Alun Malang. Then they eat bakso near the station.

items.reteach: Every Sunday, Dika goes to Malang.

items.prompt: Visitor: "Excuse me, where is the toilet?" Guard: "It is ___ the library and the canteen."
items.reteach: Di antara dua tempat: between … and …

items.prompt: Rafi wants to buy medicine. Mom says, "Go to the ___."
items.reteach: Obat dibeli di apotek: pharmacy.

items.prompt: Lia wants to swim in the sea. She goes to the ___.
items.reteach: Berenang di laut: pergi ke beach.

items.prompt: Mom: "Where are my glasses?" Dita: "They are ___ your head, Mom!"
items.reteach: Kacamata ada di atas kepala Ibu: on your head.

items.prompt: Teacher: "Class is over. Put your books ___ your bag and go home."
items.reteach: Masukkan buku ke dalam tas: in your bag.

items.prompt: Ana: "Where is Surabaya?" Teacher: "It is ___ East Java."
items.reteach: Untuk provinsi dan kota dipakai in.

items.prompt: Dad: "The car is not in the garage." Bimo: "It is ___ the house, Dad. I can see it from the front window."
items.reteach: Terlihat dari jendela depan, jadi mobil di depan rumah: in front of.

items.prompt: You are at a mall. You ask a guard: "Excuse me, where is the ___? I want to buy shoes."
items.reteach: Membeli sepatu di toko sepatu: shoe shop.

items.prompt: Grandma: "I can't find my cat." Toni looks at the table: "There it is! It is ___ the table."
items.reteach: Kucing ada di bawah meja: under.

items.prompt: Teacher: "Who sits next to you, Riko?" Riko: "Ani sits on my left and Bobi sits on my right. I sit ___ them."
items.reteach: Riko di tengah Ani dan Bobi: between them.

items.prompt: A visitor asks: "How can I get to the zoo?" Police officer: "Walk a little. The zoo is ___ the bus stop. It is very close."
items.reteach: Very close artinya sangat dekat: near.

items.prompt: Mother: "Where is your sister?" Andi: "She is ___ the kitchen. She is cooking."
items.reteach: Di dalam dapur: in the kitchen.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: is / the / under / cat / table / the

visual.text: The cat is under the table.

choices.say: The cat is under the table.

visual.text: The cat under is the table.

choices.say: The cat under is the table.

visual.text: The cat is the table under.

choices.say: The cat is the table under.

visual.text: The is cat under the table.

choices.say: The is cat under the table.

items.reteach: Pola: The cat + is + under the table.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: next / sits / to / Rina / me
items.reteach: Pola: Rina + sits + next to me.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: lives / in / Grandma / Madura
items.reteach: Pola: Grandma + lives + in Madura.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: between / is / Ani / Bobi / and / Cici

visual.text: Ani is between Bobi and Cici.

choices.say: Ani is between Bobi and Cici.

visual.text: Ani between is Bobi and Cici.

choices.say: Ani between is Bobi and Cici.

visual.text: Ani is Bobi between and Cici.

choices.say: Ani is Bobi between and Cici.

visual.text: Between is Ani Bobi and Cici.

choices.say: Between is Ani Bobi and Cici.

items.reteach: Pola: Ani + is + between Bobi and Cici.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: front / of / in / stands / the / Dad / door

visual.text: Dad stands in front of the door.

choices.say: Dad stands in front of the door.

visual.text: Dad stands in of front the door.

choices.say: Dad stands in of front the door.

visual.text: Dad in front stands of the door.

choices.say: Dad in front stands of the door.

visual.text: Dad stands front in of the door.

choices.say: Dad stands front in of the door.

items.reteach: In front of selalu berurutan: in front of.

items.prompt: Change into the opposite place: "The lamp is above the table."

visual.text: The lamp is below the table.

choices.say: The lamp is below the table.

visual.text: The lamp is beside the table.

choices.say: The lamp is beside the table.

visual.text: The lamp is on the table.

choices.say: The lamp is on the table.

visual.text: The lamp is in the table.

choices.say: The lamp is in the table.

items.reteach: Lawan above adalah below.

items.prompt: Change into the opposite place: "The car is in front of the house."

visual.text: The car is behind the house.

choices.say: The car is behind the house.

visual.text: The car is next to the house.

choices.say: The car is next to the house.

visual.text: The car is in the house.

choices.say: The car is in the house.

visual.text: The car is on the house.

choices.say: The car is on the house.

items.reteach: Lawan in front of adalah behind.

items.prompt: Change into the opposite place: "The children are inside the classroom."

visual.text: The children are outside the classroom.

choices.say: The children are outside the classroom.

visual.text: The children are under the classroom.

choices.say: The children are under the classroom.

visual.text: The children are on the classroom.

choices.say: The children are on the classroom.

visual.text: The children are between the classroom.

choices.say: The children are between the classroom.

items.reteach: Lawan inside adalah outside.

items.prompt: Change into a question: "The keys are in the bag."

visual.text: Are the keys in the bag?

choices.say: Are the keys in the bag?

visual.text: Is the keys in the bag?

choices.say: Is the keys in the bag?

visual.text: Do the keys in the bag?

choices.say: Do the keys in the bag?

visual.text: Are in the bag the keys?

choices.say: Are in the bag the keys?

items.reteach: Pindahkan are ke depan: Are the keys in the bag?

items.prompt: Arrange the words: market / to / goes / Mom / the
items.reteach: Pola: Mom + goes + to the market.

items.prompt: Change into a negative sentence: "The cat is on the roof."

visual.text: The cat is not on the roof.

choices.say: The cat is not on the roof.

visual.text: The cat not is on the roof.

choices.say: The cat not is on the roof.

visual.text: The cat does not on the roof.

choices.say: The cat does not on the roof.

visual.text: The cat is on not the roof.

choices.say: The cat is on not the roof.

items.reteach: Is + not: The cat is not on the roof.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: hanging / is / the / wall / on / clock / The

visual.text: The clock is hanging on the wall.

choices.say: The clock is hanging on the wall.

visual.text: The clock is on hanging the wall.

choices.say: The clock is on hanging the wall.

visual.text: The clock hanging is on the wall.

choices.say: The clock hanging is on the wall.

visual.text: Hanging the clock is the on wall.

choices.say: Hanging the clock is the on wall.

items.reteach: Pola: The clock + is hanging + on the wall.

items.prompt: Ani sits between Budi and Cici. Budi is on Ani's left. Who is on Ani's right?
items.reteach: Ani di tengah. Kiri Budi, jadi kanannya Cici.

items.prompt: The ball is in the box. The box is under the bed. Where is the ball?
items.reteach: Bola di dalam kotak, dan kotak di bawah tempat tidur. Jadi bola juga di bawah tempat tidur.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am a place with many books. You must be quiet inside me. What am I?
items.reteach: Banyak buku dan harus tenang: library.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am a place with sand, sun, and waves. What am I?
items.reteach: Pasir dan ombak ada di pantai: beach.

items.prompt: Odd one out: under, behind, between, happy
items.reteach: Under, behind, between adalah kata depan tempat. Happy adalah perasaan.

items.prompt: "In" is to "out" as "up" is to …
items.reteach: In ↔ out, up ↔ down.

items.prompt: There are three houses in a row: red, blue, and green. The blue house is in the middle. Which house is between the other two?
items.reteach: Yang di tengah (in the middle) ada di antara dua rumah lain.

items.prompt: The bakery is next to the bank. The bank is next to the school. They are in one row. Which place is between the bakery and the school?
items.reteach: Urutannya bakery, bank, school. Bank ada di tengah.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am a room with a stove, plates, and spoons. Mom cooks in me. What am I?
items.reteach: Memasak di dapur: kitchen.

items.prompt: Odd one out: library, bakery, market, under
items.reteach: Library, bakery, market adalah tempat. Under adalah kata depan.

items.prompt: The cat is on the chair. The dog is under the same chair. Which animal is higher?
items.reteach: On = di atas, under = di bawah. Kucing lebih tinggi.

items.prompt: Read the first letters: Park, Office, Station, Toilet. What word do you get?
items.reteach: P-O-S-T = POST.
